traditions.KJV: and eat not any unclean [ thing ] :

traditions.WLC: כִּי֩ הִנָּ֨ ךְ הָרָ֜ה וְ יֹלַ֣דְתְּ בֵּ֗ן
traditions.LXX: ὅτι ἰδοὺ σὺ ἐν γαστρὶ ἔχεις καὶ τέξῃ υἱόν ,

traditions.KJV: for the child shall be a Nazarite unto God from the womb :

5.english_reference: and he shall begin to deliver Israel out of the hand of the Philistines

traditions.VUL: et ipse incípiet liberáre Israel de manu Philisthinórum .

6.english_reference: Then the woman came and told her husband , saying

traditions.WLC: וַ תָּבֹ֣א הָ אִשָּׁ֗ה וַ תֹּ֣אמֶר לְ אִישָׁ הּ֮ לֵ אמֹר֒

traditions.VUL: Quæ cum venísset ad marítum suum , dixit ei :
traditions.KJV: Then the woman came and told her husband , saying ,

6.english_reference: A man of God came unto me

traditions.WLC: אִ֤ישׁ הָ אֱלֹהִים֙ בָּ֣א אֵלַ֔ י

traditions.KJV: A man of God came unto me ,

traditions.WLC: וּ מַרְאֵ֕ הוּ כְּ מַרְאֵ֛ה מַלְאַ֥ךְ הָ אֱלֹהִ֖ים נוֹרָ֣א מְאֹ֑ד
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἶδος αὐτοῦ ὡς εἶδος ἀγγέλου θεοῦ φοβερὸν σφόδρα ·
traditions.KJV: and his countenance [ was ] like the countenance of an angel of God , very terrible :

6.english_reference: but I asked him not whence he [ was ]

traditions.WLC: וְ לֹ֤א שְׁאִלְתִּ֨י הוּ֙ אֵֽי מִ זֶּ֣ה ה֔וּא
traditions.LXX: καὶ οὐκ ἠρώτησα αὐτὸν πόθεν ἐστίν ,
traditions.VUL: Quem cum interrogássem quis esset , et unde venísset ,
traditions.KJV: but I asked him not whence he [ was ] ,

6.english_reference: neither told he me his name

traditions.WLC: וְ אֶת שְׁמ֖ וֹ לֹֽא הִגִּ֥יד לִֽ י
traditions.LXX: καὶ τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ οὐκ ἀπήγγειλέν μοι .
traditions.VUL: et quo nómine vocarétur , nóluit mihi dícere :
traditions.KJV: neither told he me his name :

traditions.WLC: וַ יֹּ֣אמֶר לִ֔ י
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἶπέν μοι
traditions.KJV: But he said unto me ,

7.english_reference: Behold , thou shalt conceive , and bear a son

traditions.WLC: הִנָּ֥ ךְ הָרָ֖ה וְ יֹלַ֣דְתְּ בֵּ֑ן
traditions.LXX: Ἰδοὺ σὺ ἐν γαστρὶ ἔχεις καὶ τέξῃ υἱόν ·

traditions.WLC: וְ עַתָּ֞ה אַל תִּשְׁתִּ֣י יַ֣יִן וְ שֵׁכָ֗ר
traditions.LXX: καὶ νῦν μὴ πίῃς οἶνον καὶ μέθυσμα ,

traditions.KJV: and now drink no wine nor strong drink ,

traditions.WLC: וְ אַל תֹּֽאכְלִי֙ כָּל טֻמְאָ֔ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ μὴ φάγῃς πᾶν ἀκάθαρτον ,
traditions.KJV: neither eat any unclean [ thing ] :

7.english_reference: for the child shall be a Nazarite to God from the womb to the day of his death

traditions.WLC: כִּֽי נְזִ֤יר אֱלֹהִים֙ יִהְיֶ֣ה הַ נַּ֔עַר מִן הַ בֶּ֖טֶן עַד י֥וֹם מוֹתֽ וֹ

traditions.KJV: and the angel of God came again unto the woman

traditions.KJV: as she sat in the field :

traditions.LXX: καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτόν

traditions.KJV: Behold , the man hath appeared unto me ,

traditions.KJV: that came unto me the [ other ] day .

11.english_reference: And Manoah arose , and went after his wife ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יֹּ֣אמֶר ל֗ וֹ הַ אַתָּ֥ה הָ אִ֛ישׁ אֲשֶׁר דִּבַּ֥רְתָּ אֶל הָ אִשָּׁ֖ה

traditions.VUL: Cui Manue : Quando , inquit , sermo tuus fúerit explétus ,
traditions.KJV: And Manoah said , Now let thy words come to pass .

12.english_reference: How shall we order the child , and [ how ] shall we do unto him ?

traditions.WLC: מַה יִּֽהְיֶ֥ה מִשְׁפַּט הַ נַּ֖עַר וּ מַעֲשֵֽׂ הוּ
traditions.LXX: τίς ἔσται κρίσις τοῦ παιδίου καὶ τὰ ποιήματα αὐτοῦ ?
traditions.VUL: quid vis ut fáciat puer ? aut a quo se observáre debébit ?
traditions.KJV: How shall we order the child , and [ how ] shall we do unto him ?

traditions.LXX: καὶ εἶπεν ὁ ἄγγελος Κυρίου πρὸς Μανῶε

traditions.LXX: Ἀπὸ πάντων ὧν εἴρηκα πρὸς τὴν γυναῖκα φυλάξεται ·
traditions.VUL: Ab ómnibus , quæ locútus sum uxóri tuæ , abstíneat se :
traditions.KJV: Of all that I said unto the woman let her beware .

traditions.KJV: She may not eat of any [ thing ] that cometh of the vine ,

14.english_reference: neither let her drink wine or strong drink ,

traditions.WLC: וְ יַ֤יִן וְ שֵׁכָר֙ אַל תֵּ֔שְׁתְּ
traditions.LXX: καὶ οἶνον καὶ σίκερα μέθυσμα μὴ πιέτω ,
traditions.KJV: neither let her drink wine or strong drink ,

traditions.LXX: καὶ πᾶν ἀκάθαρτον μὴ φαγέτω ·
traditions.KJV: nor eat any unclean [ thing ] :

14.english_reference: all that I commanded her let her observe .

traditions.KJV: all that I commanded her let her observe .

traditions.WLC: אִם תַּעְצְרֵ֨ נִי֙ לֹא אֹכַ֣ל בְּ לַחְמֶ֔ ךָ

traditions.KJV: Though thou detain me , I will not eat of thy bread :

16.english_reference: and if thou wilt offer a burnt offering , thou must offer it unto the LORD .

traditions.KJV: and if thou wilt offer a burnt offering , thou must offer it unto the LORD .

traditions.KJV: For Manoah knew not that he [ was ] an angel of the LORD .

traditions.WLC: וַ יֹּ֧אמֶר מָנ֛וֹחַ אֶל מַלְאַ֥ךְ יְהוָ֖ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἶπεν Μανῶε πρὸς τὸν ἄγγελον Κυρίου

traditions.KJV: that when thy sayings come to pass we may do thee honour ?

traditions.KJV: And the angel of the LORD said unto him ,

traditions.KJV: Why askest thou thus after my name , seeing it [ is ] secret ?

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּ֥עַל מַלְאַךְ יְהוָ֖ה בְּ לַ֣הַב הַ מִּזְבֵּ֑חַ
